summary: Invoke a main-side handler and return a Promise for its structured-cloned response.

target.notes: Preserve request/reply correlation, structured cloning and Promise rejection behavior.

caveats: The resolved result is not the same object identity as a main-process object.
Thrown main errors are not transparently transferred as the original Error object.

tests.name: invoke result
tests.expected_behavior: resolves with the main handler result after serialization

tests.name: invoke rejection
tests.expected_behavior: rejects when the registered main handler throws/rejects
